title: UN Headquarters Plaza & Fountain, 1961 New York B&W Snapshot Photo
location: New York, New York, United States
description: An elevated, high-angle view captures the entrance plaza and fountain at the United Nations Headquarters in New York City, stamped November 1961 on the top border. Across the street, the circular driveway wraps around a large reflecting pool and fountain, flanked by security gates, flagpoles, and early 1960s automobiles. In the background rises a prominent modern curtain-wall building, reflecting the mid-century International Style of urban diplomacy during the Cold War era.
